# Stats (orange)
stats.17166969.xyz, stats-next.17166969.xyz {
	bind 100.68.104.43
	tls {
		dns cloudflare {env.CF_API_TOKEN}
	}
	log {
		output stdout
		format filter {
			wrap console
			fields {
				request>headers delete
				resp_headers delete
			}
		}
	}
	route {
		@unverifiedPeer not remote_ip 0.0.0.0/0 ::/0
		respond @unverifiedPeer 403
		request_header -Tailscale-*
		request_header -Stats-Gateway-Secret
		request_header -Rivet-Gateway-Secret
		request_header -Stats-Tailnet-Identity
		request_header -X-OO-Peer
		request_header -X-OO-Ingress
		request_header -X-Forwarded-*
		request_header -Forwarded
		request_header -X-Real-Ip
		request_header X-OO-Ingress tailnet
		forward_auth unix//run/identity/identity.sock {
			uri /auth
			header_up X-OO-Peer {http.request.remote}
			copy_headers Stats-Tailnet-Identity
		}
		@rivet {
			host stats.17166969.xyz
			path /rivet /rivet/*
		}
		handle @rivet {
			reverse_proxy 172.29.80.24:8080 {
				header_up Rivet-Gateway-Secret {$GW_SECRET_RIVET}
			}
		}
		reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:18489 {
			header_up Stats-Gateway-Secret {$GW_SECRET_RECOVERY_STATS}
		}
	}
}

# Public listener: plain HTTP on loopback only, reached by the outbound cloudflared tunnel.
# No identity sidecar and no gateway secret: the app sees `X-OO-Ingress: public` and nothing else.
# Stuff registries (public)
http://stuff.17166969.xyz:18480, http://crates.17166969.xyz:18480, http://crates-blobs.17166969.xyz:18480, http://npm.17166969.xyz:18480, http://pypi.17166969.xyz:18480, http://oci.17166969.xyz:18480, http://oci-blobs.17166969.xyz:18480, http://mirror.17166969.xyz:18480 {
	bind 127.0.0.1
	route {
		request_header -Tailscale-*
		request_header -Stats-Gateway-Secret
		request_header -Rivet-Gateway-Secret
		request_header -Stats-Tailnet-Identity
		request_header -X-OO-Peer
		request_header -X-OO-Ingress
		request_header -X-Forwarded-*
		request_header -Forwarded
		request_header -X-Real-Ip
		request_header X-OO-Ingress public
		@deny0 path /_s3 /_s3/*
		respond @deny0 404
		@denyre0 path_regexp (?i)^/+(?:\.{1,2}/+)*_s3(?:[/;]|$)
		respond @denyre0 404
		@deny1 path /_publication /_publication/*
		respond @deny1 404
		@denyre1 path_regexp (?i)^/+(?:\.{1,2}/+)*_publication(?:[/;]|$)
		respond @denyre1 404
		@deny2 path /admin /admin/*
		respond @deny2 404
		@denyre2 path_regexp (?i)^/+(?:\.{1,2}/+)*admin(?:[/;]|$)
		respond @denyre2 404
		@private_method not method GET HEAD
		header @private_method Allow "GET, HEAD"
		respond @private_method 405
		respond "app not deployed" 503
	}
}
